newsitem.title: UK: Holiday puts lid on Japanese stocks in London.
newsitem.headline: Holiday puts lid on Japanese stocks in London.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were steady to slightly weaker on Monday, with business at a near standstill because of the one-day national holiday in Japan, dealers said.
The Nikkei 50 index in London was up 1.33 points at 1,428.69 by 1329 GMT in what dealers called minimal activity.
"It's been like a morgue. We've only seen two or three orders all day and there's been little follow-through from Friday," one dealer said.
Traders noted some interest in Toyota Motor Corp. and other automobiles but said volumes were thin.
The market was expected to trend slightly lower on Tuesday, with a round of low-level profit-taking, they said.
"We had a good run up last week and people seem prepared to book profits at the moment. We might see it down in the rest of the week," one trader said.
